description: The ready-made projects a project can take in one action — today 'requirements', a register of what a company is obliged to do: an issue type, ten columns (the norm, the obligation, who answers, what proves it, when it is reviewed), a four-state workflow, the year's recurring compliance work and two wiki page templates. Says what each brings, by name, before anything is taken.
name: list_project_presets
title: List project presets
